      • enableConsole

        public static void enableConsole()

      • disableConsole

        public static void disableConsole()

      • showDebugMessage

        public static void showDebugMessage​(java.lang.String msg)
        Show debug message. This method is used for debugging purposes. Since all of the normal console prints use showMessage, only messages using showDebugMessage will be printed after disableConsole().
        Parameters:
        msg - : the message to be printed to the console.

      • showMessage

        public static void showMessage​(java.lang.String msg)
        Show message. In case consoleEnabled == false, no message will be printed. For printing debugger messages when the console is disabled, see showDebugMessage().
        Parameters:
        msg - : the message to be printed to the console.

      • showInput

        public static void showInput()
        Print indicator for indicating a user input request. Call this each time before the user is required to input something to the console.

      • showOptions

        public static void showOptions​(java.lang.String[] options)
        Show all of the Strings inside of the passed array options as a list of options on the console.
        Parameters:
        options - : the options to choose from.
        Requires
        options != null.

      • requestOption

        public static java.lang.String requestOption​(java.lang.String[] options)
        Request multiple choice input from the user in the console. This method may block while waiting for input.
        Parameters:
        options - : the options to choose from.
        Returns:
        a String from options or an empty String if an invalid input was given not corresponding to any of the options.
        Requires
        options != null.

      • requestInput

        public static java.lang.String requestInput​(java.lang.String msg)
        Request input from the user in the console. This method may block while waiting for input.
        Parameters:
        msg - : the message to be printed before asking for input.
        Returns:
        a String containing the next line of input given by the user.
        Requires
        msg != null.

      • showPossibleMoves
